svg.text: Net assessment
What holds, what fails, what is still open
1SAR refinement review · openscientist artefact cdba2c07 · re-run 2026-09-07
protstruct_review · update deck 2026-09-07
Holds
✓ The refinement is a real, large improvement
✓ Geometry, waters, disulfides, ion identity defensible
✓ A/B interface reproduces the deposition (CAPRI High)
✓ Both H builders agree on every confident flip
✓ SS agreement at the deposited baseline
✓ Oracle R-free reproduces May to four decimals
Fails
✗ Reported R-free 0.199 matches no model produced
✗ …and no round: best was 0.2068 (round 6)
✗ The shipped final is not the best round
✗ SO4 written as ATOM, not HETATM
Open
T02 blocked on tooling · mmtbx.reduce2 unregistered in the catalog · the T05 rmsz legs still carry their
disclosed gemmi 0.7.4 measurement and have not been re-run under 0.7.5.
The one failing claim is unchanged in verdict and clearer in cause. Five code paths now bracket
R-free at 0.2114–0.2136 once mask conventions are matched. The gap is not between oracles, and not
between the oracle and the model — it is between the model and the report written about it.
